name: Pixi Glow Tonic Serum 30ml Lightweight Hydrating and Exfoliating Facial Serum with Glycolic Acid
description:
Achieve a radiant complexion with Pixi Glow Tonic Serum, a lightweight facial serum that hydrates, nourishes, and gently exfoliates. Formulated with glycolic acid to smooth skin texture and brighten tone, this serum also contains aloe vera to soothe and ginseng to revitalize. Fast-absorbing and suitable for all skin types, it helps purify pores, boost circulation, and enhance skin’s natural glow. Paraben-free, cruelty-free, and perfect for daily use as part of your skincare routine.
Key Features:
Volume: 30ml / 1.01 fl oz
Glycolic acid gently exfoliates and refines skin texture
Aloe vera extract hydrates and soothes
Ginseng energizes and improves circulation
Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula for daily use
Paraben-free and cruelty-free
How to Use:
Use morning and evening or as needed
Cleanse skin with facial cleanser
Apply toner before serum
Massage 2–3 drops of Glow Tonic Serum onto clean, dry skin
Follow with moisturizer
Ingredients:
Glycolic Acid moisturizes & renews
Aloe Vera soothes & calms
Ginseng revitalizes & balances
Safety Information:
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Use sunscreen during the day when applying glycolic acid products
